# Kseniya Bortnikova

## PhD Candidate in Economics

**Institute of Economic Studies, Charles University, Prague**
:::

::: {.about-text}
I am a PhD candidate and researcher at the Institute of Economic Studies, Charles University. My research interests include meta-analysis, applied and financial econometrics, labour economics, and the economics of beauty.

Much of my research uses meta-analysis to examine how empirical findings vary across studies and how much of a reported effect remains once selective reporting is taken into account. My work is mainly in labour and financial economics, with a particular interest in the economics of beauty. I also work on questions in health economics and applied policy.

Alongside my research, I teach at Charles University and the Prague University of Economics and Business (VŠE), including courses in econometrics, game theory, financial management, and international finance.
:::
